title: Boston Gas Company submits for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Saunstar Operating Company LLC d/b/a Boston Park Plaza.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Boston Gas Company files responses to the Attorney General's Information and Data Requests. By: Thomas P. O'Neil, Counsel of Boston Gas Company. (GC 00-14)

The Department APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds tha the pricing terms to be purchased under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chair; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC 00-14)
Attorney General's data and information requests. By: John M. Grugan. Assistant Attorney General. (GC 00-14)
